clusters.reasoning: All raw filenames share the same run naming scheme with only m/z window suffixes (0400-0800, 0700-1100, 1000-1400) and a 'SW' marker consistent with label swapping. Therefore, all files are grouped into the single BS3 condition for Imh1-C213 ± glycerol.
